title: Blood Censor Pack (Lime Transparent)
description: A pack that censors blood simulated via redstone particles making it transparent green
body:
# Tired of seeing blood when punching mobs?
This resourcepack changes that by recolouring the redstone block texture often used to simulate blood on servers
![green transparent blood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b56fb6ddb286466b49da81141698914354c2572.png)
